context: Aoi and Riku talk about a live concert.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: music chat; performance vocabulary (演奏/ライブ/クラブ/魅力/年代) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日のライブ、すごかったよ!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 演奏は、どんな感じだった?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 演奏が、耳に心地よくてさ。
lines.en: The performance was pleasing to the ear.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm admiring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あのバンドの魅力は、声だよね。
lines.en: That band's charm is the vocals.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 小さなクラブだったけど、最高だった。
lines.en: It was a small club, but it was the best.
lines.style: happy teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: チケットは、高くなかった?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと高くても、魅力で十分元が取れた。
lines.en: Even a bit pricey, the charm made it worth it.
lines.style: satisfied teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私の年代も、ああいう演奏が好きだな。
lines.en: My generation likes that kind of playing too.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm fond delivery throughout
